code_samples.title: Trending filter
Thresholds
code_samples.content:
# Launch MEV Sol Trending v1 thresholds

# Dedicated audit / position paths (override cradle defaults)
LAUNCH_MEV_CANDIDATES_NDJSON_PATH=[path redacted]
LAUNCH_MEV_TRADES_NDJSON_PATH=[path redacted]
LAUNCH_MEV_EXITS_NDJSON_PATH=[path redacted]
LAUNCH_MEV_POSITIONS_JSON_PATH=[path redacted]
LAUNCH_MEV_POSITIONS_LOCK_PATH=[path redacted]

# Signer isolation — set in [path redacted] gate-live enforces != LAUNCH_MEV_SOL_KEYPAIR_PATH
# LAUNCH_MEV_SOL_TRENDING_KEYPAIR_PATH=

# Discovery — Playwright bridge (primary) + Gecko fallback
TRENDING_DISCOVERY_MODE=bridge
DEXSCREENER_BRIDGE_URL=[endpoint redacted]
DEXSCREENER_BRIDGE_HEALTH_URL=[endpoint redacted]
DEXSCREENER_BRIDGE_PORT=9099
DEXSCREENER_BRIDGE_RECONNECT_MS=1000
DEXSCREENER_BRIDGE_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS=30000
DEXSCREENER_BRIDGE_ONCE_TIMEOUT_MS=45000
BRIDGE_RESTART_AFTER_MINUTES=120
TRENDING_DISCOVERY_POLL_MS=5000
TRENDING_DISCOVERY_REST_FALLBACK=true

# Bridge screener URL filters (also used by playwright-dexscreener-bridge.js)
DEXSCREENER_WS_RANK_BY=priceChangeM5
DEXSCREENER_WS_MIN_LIQUIDITY_USD=25000
DEXSCREENER_WS_MIN_TXNS_H24=50
DEXSCREENER_WS_MIN_VOLUME_H24_USD=10000
DEXSCREENER_WS_PROFILE_MIN=1
DEXSCREENER_WS_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS=60000

# Trending filter (post-ingest)
SCREENER_MIN_PRICE_CHANGE_5M_PCT=5
SCREENER_MIN_LIQUIDITY_USD=25000
SCREENER_MIN_VOLUME_24H_USD=10000
SCREENER_MIN_TXNS_H24=50
SCREENER_MIN_MARKET_CAP_USD=100000
SCREENER_MAX_MARKET_CAP_USD=10000000
SCREENER_MIN_PAIR_AGE_SEC=3600

# TWAP entry
TWAP_ENTRY_SLICES=5
TWAP_ENTRY_INTERVAL_MS=3000
TWAP_ENTRY_SLIPPAGE_BPS=100
LAUNCH_MEV_SOL_RISK_UNIT_SOL=0.5

# TWAP exit + snipe tier1 (15m hold vs 30m cradle)
LAUNCH_MEV_TWAP_SELL_FRAC=0.10
LAUNCH_MEV_TWAP_INTERVAL_MS=2000
LAUNCH_MEV_TWAP_HOLD_AFTER_MS=900000
LAUNCH_MEV_TIER1_PNL_PCT=30
LAUNCH_MEV_TIER1_SELL_FRAC=0.25
LAUNCH_MEV_HARD_STOP_PCT=-20
LAUNCH_MEV_LATE_HARD_STOP_PCT=-15

decision_replay.disclaimer: Policy regression replay only. This is not a historical market backtest and does not verify profitability.
